newsitem.title: USA: San Jose Water names Weinhardt chairman.
newsitem.headline: San Jose Water names Weinhardt chairman.

text.p: San Jose Water Corp said Thursday it has appointed J.W. Weinhardt as chairman and chief executive.
The company also said in a statement it appointed Richard Roth as president and Angela Yip as chief financial officer and treasurer.

Weinhardt had served as president and chief executive officer since the formation of the corporation in 1985. Roth had served as vice president since April 1992 and chief financial officer and treasurer since January 1990. Yip has served as the chief financial officer and treasurer of unit San Jose Water Co since October 1994.
